name: independent_new_v1_matched_scale_frequency_and_ring_spectrum_analysis
cells: validation and final separately; pooled, subject and controlled-condition groups; exact matching native trial IDs and labels
conditional: joint arm minus each base-plus-other arm in log loss, Brier and macro-F1; positive delta_log_loss means the addition lowers held-out loss
error_complementarity: selected single-addition pair per dataset: error correlation, predicted-label disagreement and exact four-way correctness contingency
interaction: P(base+a+b)-P(base+a)-P(base+b)+P(base), P=-held-out log loss; macro-F1 auxiliary
selection: pure saved-prediction post-hoc analysis; no classifier fitting or final-set model selection
scope: new independently implemented 8-channel candidate families, not exact historical X1-H, RLCS, CES or frequency-code reproduction
boundary: different devices and class sets; validation/final separate; final users inspected in earlier project studies
